entries.brief: Create ONE square original painterly fantasy spell icon for SKAZ, a restrained high-quality fantasy encyclopedia. Broad sculpted brush shapes, clear silhouette readable at 32 px, moderate detail, soft warm light from upper left. Rich material shading with dark defined edges, not vector clipart. Composition fills 80% with safe margins. Isolated on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No text, letters, digits, frame, UI symbols, scenery, ground, logo or background haze. Subject: one magical arrow made of luminous viscous acid, a sharp unmistakable triangular arrowhead and short thin shaft flying diagonally lower-left to upper-right, with three heavy green droplets trailing behind. Yellow-green translucent fluid surface, dark olive edges, pale ivory highlights, a small bubbling acid splash around the arrowhead. No bow, no fire, no lightning, no poison cloud; one compact projectile.
